'''Roan's assistant''' was the assistant of [[Roan]], who was governor of [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]] at the time. He led [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to the [[Secret meeting room]], located in the [[Institute of Government Service]] next to Roan's office.
